title: The Chained Devil
text: A devil chained to a pillar, wings torn, begs to be freed in a voice like honey. The chains are inscribed with a warning in a script none of you can read. It promises to show you the way out of the Pit, and it swears on everything it does not have.

options.label: Break its chains, and trust that even a devil can keep its word.

outcomes.text: It keeps its word, to everyone's surprise, and shows the way out. It does not say what it will do next.
It keeps its word, in its own way, which is not your way, and you learn the difference the hard way.

options.label: The shrewdest asks why it was chained, before anyone frees it.

outcomes.text: It lied to the wrong devil. It tells you who, very gladly, and in great detail.

options.label: Leave it chained. Whoever bound it here knew what it was.

outcomes.text: It curses you as you go, sweetly, by name.
